Diagnosis.submission: The frontend Service has a corrupted selector. Its selector is set to {service-route: frontend} (deviating from the original applied selector {io.kompose.service: frontend} and from the convention used by every other service in the namespace). The injected fault also added the label service-route=frontend to BOTH the frontend pod AND the search pod. As a result the frontend Service endpoints incorrectly include the search pod (10.244.162.180) on port 5000, but the search gRPC service does not listen on 5000. This causes roughly 50% of requests to the frontend ClusterIP to fail (HTTP 000 / connection errors) since requests are load-balanced onto the search pod. Root cause: service selector/pod label mismatch adding the search pod to the frontend Service.
